important_points: Indonesia's benchmark stock index plunged over 5% on Monday to its lowest level in six years, as concerns over a potential downgrade by MSCI intensified fears of further foreign investor outflows.

important_points: China's economic growth accelerated to 4.5% in the third quarter from a year earlier, as robust foreign demand for the country's technological goods largely offset drags from a deepening property slump and sluggish consumer demand.

items.title: Why hedge funds could be making a bond market shock more likely
items.title_zh: Why hedge funds could be making a bond market shock more likely
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：Hedge funds' increased presence in global bond markets makes the likelihood of a broader market shock "greater than what it was," Bank of England deputy governor Sarah Breeden told CNBC Thursday.；Breeden — the central bank's deputy governor for financial stability, and a member of its rates-setting Monetary Policy Committee — said the changing mix of bond market investors, and their increased use of leverage, raises the risk of localized market turbulence turning into broader financial stress.；"One of the things that has become increasingly apparent over the last several years is that the investors in our core government bond markets globally have changed," Breeden told CNBC's Sri Jegarajah in an interview Thursday.
important_points: Hedge funds' increased presence in global bond markets makes the likelihood of a broader market shock "greater than what it was," Bank of England deputy governor Sarah Breeden told CNBC Thursday.

Breeden — the central bank's deputy governor for financial stability, and a member of its rates-setting Monetary Policy Committee — said the changing mix of bond market investors, and their increased use of leverage, raises the risk of localized market turbulence turning into broader financial stress.

"One of the things that has become increasingly apparent over the last several years is that the investors in our core government bond markets globally have changed," Breeden told CNBC's Sri Jegarajah in an interview Thursday.
